name: dev-sidecar
description: 开发者边车，github加速、npm加速、git加速、助力开发者
author: docmirror
_note: personal fork for learning purposes - upstream: docmirror/dev-sidecar
_local_notes: added test:verbose script for easier debugging when tests fail; added test:watch for dev workflow; added test:coverage and bumped jest timeout to 20s since some proxy tests can be slow on my machine; enabled verbose by default so I always see individual test names; bumped timeout further to 30s because I kept hitting timeouts on flaky network days; added test:ci for running in a clean environment with --forceExit so jest doesn't hang; added testPathIgnorePatterns explicitly just to be safe; added collectCoverageFrom so coverage report actually covers the right files and ignores noise; added coverageThreshold at 50% lines just so I notice if I accidentally delete a bunch of tested code; added coverageReporters so I get html output I can open in browser plus lcov for any tooling
